structural_change: HC ring bank 734.4x734.4 -> 777.6x734.4 (one 43.2 lattice step in x): HBM-ELEMOWN3 10-19: b0 takes the L2H-HC cb_s1 SAFE geometry (cb_s1 gate: trial GRT overflow 0, CTS pin-flop insertion 1146-1194 ps TT); the cb SAFE redesign after the 07:30 --cts gate FAIL (spread 143/155 ps, trial GRT stalled >4 h in incremental global_route): the 8 weight SRAMs leave the abutted off-lattice stack (pitch 70.512) for four abutted PAIRS on the lane rows (y43.2/216/388.8/561.6, pair = 2 x 70.488 abutted at the 70.512 track pitch, 31.8 um channels between pairs; macro g beside lane row g//2), and the SRAM-E-face -> lane-W-face pin channel widens 41.3 -> 84.5 um (lanes x302.4/475.2, x-SRAMs x648 on lattice rows). Goes with the next die gen (claude/hc-ringplan-1019).  HC quarter engine (plan (b) d4g, HBM-B-RTL2b): 3x3 ring of 8 bank tiles around the hub (hc_<q> + centre, coordinator 10-17 23:45: no empty middle). Chain clockwise from W: b0 W, b1 NW, b2 N, b3 NE, b4 E, b5 SE, b6 S, b7 SW; masters by pin plan (R0 / R180 only): e2 = b2 / b6, e0 = b4, b0 = b0, ca = b1 / b5, cb = b3 / b7. Inside: 8 closed lane leaves hc_lanes_ref (2 cols x 4 rows, 43.2 lattice), the 8 weight macros as ONE abutted N-S stack W of the leaves (pins E, facing them; macro g beside leaf row g//2), the 4 x macros E of the leaves at their rows. b0: first = 1 (no sum_in/f_in ports); the DRLY chain-exit relay of bank 7 sits here (S -> E). HH-9 10-19 (47247cc08 FLOORPLAN_MARGIN bank_distance, no lint override): CHAIN PIN REGISTERS at the tile faces (RTL ot_hbm_hc_bankq_core CPI/CPO; qeng CPR 1, centre CHX / root QCHX 11): the chain flops were inside the lane leaves, 550 um from the faces (bank->bank hop ~1.1 mm); now every hop is face flop -> face flop and no leaf is wired to a block pin. Chain pins spread over the full faces (3.5 b/um, e2 convention). MX middle band rejected: M4+M6 W/E leaf pins cannot be mirrored on track; corner/b0 banks have no 100 um leaf placement at all. HCRING 10-19 (HH-9 flag, R0->R180 joints): route.pin_balance gives every face a defined bit order (PPL chunks of 32 scattered the buses); faces that abut an R180 neighbour are the mirror image of that neighbour's shared face (range 734.4 - x, high bit first: pin_order_desc). HCBANK 10-19: DRLY 2 (HC-RINGPLAN GEN2d closed ring: b7 abuts b0, hcx die relay removed; the 2-stage chain-exit relay of bank 7 now sits in b0).
